rules.sentence: Fatal cardiac dysrhythmias may cause approximately 10% of deaths previously attributed to SIDS.
Cardiac channelopathies (eg, long QT syndrome and other ion channel defects) can cause sudden cardiac arrest in infancy and may be discovered on postmortem molecular autopsy or family testing.
Postmortem genetic testing for cardiac channelopathy panels should be considered, particularly when the family history is positive or when there are recurrent deaths in the family.[42][43][44]
